Assessor Guide Converter

Drop in an existing TAFE Victoria assessor guide and get it back in the right RMIT VE assessor guide template. Everything the tool finds is shown for review before the Word file is built, and anything it could not place is flagged rather than guessed.

Step 1: Drop an existing TAFE Victoria assessor guide

A Word .docx file. Question tables headed Question 1, Question 2 and so on are read question by question, with answers taken from red text. Assessment detail tables (time allowed, location, resources and so on) are read by their row labels.

Drop the TAFE Victoria assessor guide (.docx) here or press Enter to browse. Nothing is uploaded, it all happens in this browser tab.

Step 2: Choose the template

The suggestion is based on what was found in the source. Change it if the task is really a different type of evidence.

What was found

Step 3: Check the details

Fields with a yellow border were not found in the source. Anything left blank keeps the template's own guidance text, so it is obvious in Word what still needs doing. In list fields, put one item per line.

Step 4: Check the questions

Output options

Privacy: the file is read by this page in your browser. Nothing is sent anywhere.
